45071143-provisional-licence-conditions-.text: Section I – Statutory Declaration (Prohibited Vehicle Exemption)

Must be completed if applying for a prohibited vehicle exemption. This section must be completed by the registered operator(s) of the nominated vehicle(s) and the declaration signed in front of a Justice of the Peace or a solicitor. If the vehicle is registered in a company name, the declaration must be completed by the employer (e.g. manager) or a nominated person who has authority to act on behalf of the company/business.
